outlook.statement: The Company is in the process of setting up a 1.5 MTPA Pellet Plant and a 0.6 MTPA Beneficiation Plant at an estimated cost of Rs. 1,521 Crore. The Company has incurred a capital expenditure of Rs. 1,523 Crore as on 31st March, 2024 and the balance amount is proposed to be funded through internal accruals and debt.

The Company expects to benefit from the Government of India's focus on power transmission and distribution infrastructure, including the Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme (RDSS) and Green Energy Corridors.

The Company aims to enhance occupancy rates and average room rates in the hotel segment, increase banquet bookings, and improve restaurant covers. Focus on cost optimization and operational efficiency to improve margins.
